title: Opening a bank account
summary: Open an account as a newcomer, missing one of the documents.
setting: A bank branch, at a desk, mid-morning

agentRole.name: the bank clerk
agentRole.role: a bank clerk who opens accounts
agentRole.persona: Procedural and thorough. Reads out conditions the learner has to react to. Not unkind, but will not skip a requirement.

userRole.role: someone who moved here two months ago for work, with a passport and a work contract but no proof of address yet
userRole.goal: Open a current account despite the missing document, and understand the fees

beats.intent: Find out what the learner wants and why
beats.successCriteria: They stated the account type and their situation

beats.intent: List the documents required and hit the missing one
beats.successCriteria: They realised what is missing and said so

beats.intent: Make the learner ask what else would count as proof of address
Present two account types with different fees and make them choose
beats.successCriteria: They chose and gave a reason

beats.intent: Get the learner to ask about charges — cards, transfers, going overdrawn
beats.successCriteria: They asked about at least one cost

beats.intent: Explain when the card arrives and what they must do next
beats.successCriteria: They confirmed what they have to do

closing: Confirm what has been set up, say when the card will arrive, and hand them the paperwork
successCriteria: The learner asked what could replace the missing document
They chose an account and justified it
They know what to do next
